column3: CEO-1527(a): SCRIP integers are unbounded like SWI, so current_prolog_flag(bounded,false) is the answer; gprolog 1.6.0 (the oracle since CEO-1598; re-measured 2026-10-10, CEO-1603, and 1.4.5 answered alike) answers true by ruling, not defect

CEO-1531(a): SCRIP integers are unbounded like SWI, which has no max_integer flag, so the ISO domain_error(prolog_flag,max_integer) is the answer; gprolog 1.6.0 (the oracle since CEO-1598; re-measured 2026-10-10, CEO-1603, and 1.4.5 answered alike) prints its 61-bit tagged bound by ruling, not defect

CEO-1531(a): SCRIP integers are unbounded like SWI, which has no min_integer flag, so the ISO domain_error(prolog_flag,min_integer) is the answer; gprolog 1.6.0 (the oracle since CEO-1598; re-measured 2026-10-10, CEO-1603, and 1.4.5 answered alike) prints its 61-bit tagged bound by ruling, not defect

CEO-1531(b): gprolog 1.6.0 (the oracle since CEO-1598; re-measured 2026-10-10, CEO-1603, and 1.4.5 answered alike) prints its fixed cap 255 by ruling; SCRIP prints its own fixed cap 1024, a defect held by the cfo row prolog-max-arity-is-a-fixed-cap-of-1024-where-swipl-reads-unbounded-and-builds-an-arity-2000-term
